swms.title: Rewire a house
swms.task: Rewire a house: run new cables in the ceiling space and walls, and replace the switchboard.

facts.isolationProcedure: The supply is isolated at the main switch and the meter fuse is pulled by the distributor where needed. Circuits are locked and danger tagged, and tested de-energised by the licensed electrician before work. Each worker holds their own lock.
